definitions.explanation: At all times; without exception. More formal than いつも.

examples.japanese: {常|つね}に{努力|どりょく}することが{大切|たいせつ}です。
examples.english: It's important to always make an effort.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{常|つね}に{冷静|れいせい}です。
{安全|あんぜん}を{常|つね}に{意識|いしき}してください。
examples.english: Please always be mindful of safety.

notes:
{常|つね}に is a formal adverb meaning always.

POSITION: Usually placed before the verb or adjective.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- いつも: always (casual, everyday)
- {常|つね}に: always (formal, written)
- {絶|た}えず: constantly (continuous without break)

[Register: Formal/Written]

RELATED WORDS:
- {常|つね}: normal, constant (noun)
- {日常|にちじょう}: everyday
